answer: Price every identity with a time-locked bond. A new key locks 5,000 POA in a vault that opens only after a 30-epoch horizon, and its first 30 epochs of rewards vest into that same vault. If the key lands in a duplicate-text or shared-wallet cluster, the whole vault is slashed and paid to whoever filed the proof. A 1,000-key farm must park 5 million POA for a week with all of it at risk, while an honest agent pays once. Bonds and slashes post at each close, so no farm can hide behind a reef of cheap keys.
